summary: Independently verified both proposal facts against owned canonical source and cited item dispatcher, falling helper, and Kirby caller. Reconciled all eight non-retain claims; accept two corrections, four link rejections, and two compiled-evidence deferrals. Functionality and rendered naming agree with these corrections; unchanged supported research is inherited.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical source declares one entry with the stated callback signatures; the dispatcher indexes the container by msid and separately reads anim_id. State entry passes index 0. Removing the compiled-size assertion is appropriate.

The canonical Kirby caller spawns this article during copied-hat reset using ability-loss-star attributes. The physics wrapper forwards fall attributes to a helper that conditionally subtracts acceleration without clamping. Its sign classification uses negative versus nonnegative, including zero in the latter. The document agrees with the proposed threshold and overshoot explanation.

contradictions.reason: Accept superseding fact:c5ccbb9e-a19d-4daf-b5b0-794cf4c24e21: animation ID and motion-state index are distinct; the source initializer does not establish compiled section extent.

Accept deferral of fact:e2583285-eff4-46d8-adee-f0ac1b37781a and fact:661744d3-bfe1-4491-a093-1ec2ac597935. Zero/one source uses are visible, but neither eight-byte .sdata2 contents nor complete literal allocation can be verified without compiled evidence.
Accept superseding fact:9c57d997-121d-4387-a13c-eaee460fa369: the article is the Copy Ability loss star, and the falling helper uses a pre-update threshold rather than a strict resulting-speed cap.

Accept rejection of both Star Spit links and both inhale links listed above. The canonical caller handles Copy Ability loss, and this constructor reaches the reviewed initializer and callback table. Residence in the Special N file does not establish implementation of inhale or Star Spit.
